visualBrief: Granada’s hilltop Alcazaba, the Nasrid palaces and their Lions and Myrtles courts, the circular palace of Charles V, and the Partal and fortified towers.
limitations: Exterior and open-courtyard reconstruction of the Alcazaba, Nasrid palaces, Charles V Palace, principal gates, Partal and selected eastern towers. Generalife is independently placed and retains ownership of its gardens and structures.

Terrarium establishes relative grade. The three court floors, fort ramparts and tower heights use reconstructed architectural levels. Reliefs, lion figures, decorative plaster and carved roof details are interpreted at World Viewer scale.
Closed rooms and exact masonry surveys are outside this exterior model. The remaining grounds, road network, gardens and unrelated water stay with the map.

photoFacing.frontBasis: The named PMTiles towers and courtyard rings fix the relative orientation of the western fort, central Nasrid complex and eastern towers.

terrain: Bilinear six-meter sampling from standard zoom-15 Terrarium tiles.
